 Ausar Thompson fills stat sheet Wednesday against 76ers 
 by Chris Schommer | Pistons Correspondent | Fri, Nov 6th 2026, 9:14pm EST 
 Ausar Thomspon filled the stat sheet for the Pistons Wednesday night, dishing out three assists, recording one steal, grabbing 17 rebounds, and chipping in 11 points (4-10 FG, 3-4 FT) in a 112-106 loss to the 76ers. 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Thompson continues an impactful stretch on both ends of the floor, finishing with two or more assists, six or more rebounds, and seven or more points in each of his last five contests. The wing provides head coach JB Bickerstaff with one of the more versatile options in a physical Detroit starting five, averaging 9.9 points, 1.0 steals, 4.7 assists, and 8.6 rebounds per game to go along with a 17.7% usage rate so far this season.
